structural-causal.name: bottleneckControl
structural-causal.basis: Security control and telemetry sit directly between expanding digital attack surfaces and enterprise continuity.

structural-causal.name: scenarioRobustness
structural-causal.basis: Network, cloud, endpoint, identity and AI security needs persist across multiple technology architectures.

structural-causal.name: substitutionResilience
structural-causal.basis: Integrated breadth raises switching friction, while hyperscalers and focused security vendors remain credible substitutes.

structural-causal.name: crossDivisionLeverage
structural-causal.basis: Shared telemetry and platform distribution can connect acquired identity, observability and agentic capabilities if integration succeeds.

discovery-weak-signals.name: agentic-security surface expansion
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Multiple acquisitions cover gateway, endpoint, identity and operational-agent workflows.

discovery-weak-signals.name: platform integration burden
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Rapid acquisition-led breadth creates meaningful integration and execution requirements.

adversarial-red-team.name: integrationRisk
adversarial-red-team.basis: Multiple large and small acquisitions in one year increase product, accounting, workforce and go-to-market integration load.

adversarial-red-team.name: shareBasedCompensation
adversarial-red-team.basis: FY2026 SBC rose to $1.815 billion, including acquisition-related acceleration.

adversarial-red-team.name: competitiveResponse
adversarial-red-team.basis: Platform breadth competes against hyperscaler bundles and specialist vendors that can innovate faster in narrow domains.

adversarial-red-team.name: confidenceInflation
adversarial-red-team.basis: NGS ARR/platform metrics support execution, but long-range FY28/FY30 goals remain contingent on integration and margin conversion.

expectations-execution.name: platform execution
expectations-execution.basis: Large net-new NGS ARR and broad platform strength are current operating evidence supporting platformization.

expectations-execution.name: long-range expectation burden
expectations-execution.basis: Explicit FY28 margin and FY30 ARR targets raise the standard for sustained execution.

items.risk: Acquisition breadth can create product overlap, integration cost and execution complexity.
Strong AI-security expectations and acquisition activity increase disappointment risk if cross-sell, integration or margins lag targets.
Successor bottleneck is integration: acquisition breadth only creates durable platform leverage if products, data, identity and go-to-market become coherent rather than additive complexity.
Acquisition pace can create overlap, execution distraction and returns below purchase assumptions.
Large share-based compensation and assumed replacement awards can weaken per-share conversion even when operating metrics improve.
CyberArk convertible-note obligations and acquisition cash usage add capital-allocation complexity.
